method: description optimization: realistic positive prompts plus hard near-misses

live_run.note: Pending: feed each prompt to the target agent and record whether edcopilot-system-content loaded. Set performed to true, name the agent, and add one {id, fired} result per case. The tests reject a completed run that contains a miss or an over-trigger, and the description is revised only when such a run shows one.

static_run.method: Vocabulary and intent grading of every prompt against the frontmatter description. This is the deterministic half of the evaluation, not agent activation.
